name: party.armful/armful
title: Armful
description: Floral recipes to wholesale orders in whole bunches and arrangement prices, for florists.

tools.name: bunches_to_order
tools.description: How many bunches (or packs) of one flower to order for a number of arrangements, with spare stems for breakage, what is left over, and the cost. Uses the same arithmetic as the Armful app and its free calculator.

arrangements.description: How many arrangements use this flower

stems_each.description: Stems of this flower in each arrangement

stems_per_bunch.description: Stems in one bunch or pack from the wholesaler, for example 10 or 25

spare_percent.description: Extra stems for breakage, percent. Default 10

bunch_price.description: Price of one bunch, in dollars. Optional

tools.name: price_arrangement
tools.description: Prices one floral arrangement (a recipe) the way Armful does: fresh flowers and greenery with spare stems times the flower markup, hard goods times their markup, labor as a percent of both, rounded up. Give how many of it an event needs to also get the wholesale order rounded to whole bunches.

items.description: The stems and hard goods in one arrangement

pack_size.description: Stems or pieces in one wholesale bunch, box, or pack

pack_price.description: Price of one bunch, box, or pack, in dollars

arrangements.description: How many of this arrangement the event needs. Default 1

flower_markup.description: Times wholesale, for flowers and greenery. Default 3.5

hard_goods_markup.description: Times wholesale, for hard goods. Default 2

labor_percent.description: Labor as a percent of the marked-up goods. Default 25

spare_percent.description: Extra stems for breakage, percent. Default 15

round_to.description: Round each arrangement up to the cent (0), $1, $5, or $10. Default 1

tools.name: search_armful_help
tools.description: Searches Armful's help articles and its sourced guides for florists (stems per arrangement, bunch sizes, spare stems, pricing, retainers, ordering ahead). Returns the best matches with their answers and links.

query.description: What to look for, for example "how many stems in a bridal bouquet"

tools.name: about_armful
tools.description: What Armful is, who it is for, what it costs, what it does not do, and where to open it.
